body:
## Architecture Finding

**Type**: interface-violation (release-channel contract has two writers)
**Affected area**: `.github/workflows/build-final.yml`, `.github/workflows/build-iso.yml`, `scripts/resolve-image-tags.sh`, `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`, `runbooks/rollback-a-bad-stable-release.md`

`docs/ci-and-iso-pipeline.md` and the rollback runbook define the stable channel as **promotion-only**: `promote-stable.yml` copies the digest of one main build to `:stable` and builds the stable ISO from it. It does this only after the ISO boot, plain install and LUKS install gates pass on that same digest (#309, `tests/pytest/test_release_candidate.py`).

There is a second writer that skips all of those gates. A maintainer only has to run `gh workflow run build-tromso-multirunner.yml -R tuna-os/tromso --ref stable`:

1. `build-final.yml` `Push to GHCR` runs when `github.ref == 'refs/heads/stable'` (lines 294, 303, 333, 350). `scripts/resolve-image-tags.sh` turns `refs/heads/stable` into `stable stable-<date> <sha>`. A **fresh, unpromoted rebuild** goes to `:stable`, and no plain or LUKS install has run on that digest.
2. `build-iso.yml` has `workflow_run` with `branches: [main, stable]` (line 43), and a `workflow_dispatch` upstream run passes its `if` guard. `Determine channel` resolves `stable`. No candidate is passed, so `payload_ref` is the **mutable tag** `ghcr.io/tuna-os/tromso:stable` and not a digest. `publish` then signs the ISO and uploads it to R2 `tromso/stable/`.

The same dispatch also moves `:stable-aarch64` when `build_aarch64=true`. The runbook lists that as the *intended* writer of the aarch64 stable tags ("multirunner aarch64 job (manual dispatch only)"). It also tells operators to look for rollback targets among `--branch stable` multirunner runs. That points them at the ungated path as a normal source of stable builds.

The path is latent today because the `stable` branch does not exist yet (`git ls-remote` on 2026-11-19 shows only `main`, and `promote-stable.yml` is `disabled_manually`). It opens the moment the branch is created for the first promotion. Note: the promote job's `compare/stable...SHA` call returns 404 while the branch is missing, so someone has to create `stable` by hand before the first promotion can succeed.

## Impact

- `:stable` and the published stable ISO can carry a digest that never went through the gates documented as the release contract. Users of `bootc upgrade` on `:stable` and people downloading `tromso/stable/tromso-live-latest.iso` get it.
- That stable ISO embeds a tag instead of a digest. The image an install pulls can then differ from the one the ISO boot gate checked, which is the exact failure #309 removed from the promotion path.
- The `resolve-image-tags.sh` tests (`tests/pytest/test_publication_contract.py`, `tests/bats/test_resolve_image_tags.bats`) assert that a stable-ref build *does* produce `stable`. The test suite therefore protects the bypass.

## Recommendation

Decision taken by hive: `:stable` and `tromso/stable/` get exactly one gated writer, `promote-stable.yml`, plus `rollback-stable.yml` as the human-dispatched undo. Builds on the `stable` ref no longer push or publish. This is the simplest change: it removes a path and adds none. The aarch64 stable tags lose their writer. The pipeline docs already say "The aarch64 images are not part of this gate", so this matches the stated contract. The runbook row is updated to say they are not published.

**This lane's token cannot push workflow files**, so the architect lane opens no PR. The change below is complete: one PR applies all of it.

### `.github/workflows/build-final.yml`

Make the same replacement on all four lines (294 `Login to GHCR (podman)`, 303 `Push to GHCR`, 333 `Trivy image scan`, 350 `Upload Trivy scan results`):

```diff
-        if: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/stable') && inputs.push_image }}
+        if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.push_image }}
```

line 52:

```diff
-        description: 'Push and scan the image (main and stable only)'
+        description: 'Push and scan the image (main only; :stable moves only through promote-stable.yml)'
```

### `.github/workflows/build-iso.yml`

line 43 (`workflow_run`):

```diff
-    branches: [main, stable]
+    branches: [main]
```

The stable ISO is still built and published by `promote-stable.yml` → `publish-stable-iso` (`release_channel: stable`), and `Determine channel` still handles that input.

### `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`

line 18. Promoted candidates are main builds, which carry the `:<sha>` tag:

```diff
-        description: 'Full commit SHA to roll back to (must have a ghcr :<sha> image tag — find candidates via: gh run list --workflow "Build Tromso (Multi-Runner)" --branch stable --status success)'
+        description: 'Full commit SHA to roll back to (must have a ghcr :<sha> image tag — find candidates via: gh run list --workflow "Promote main to stable" --status success)'
```

### `runbooks/rollback-a-bad-stable-release.md`

line 20:

```diff
-| aarch64 image | `:stable-aarch64`, `:stable-YYYYMMDD-aarch64`, `:<sha>-aarch64` | multirunner aarch64 job (manual dispatch only) |
+| aarch64 image | not published: only `promote-stable.yml` writes stable tags, and it promotes x86_64 only | — |
```

lines 57–58:

```diff
-gh run list --repo tuna-os/tromso \
-  --workflow "Build Tromso (Multi-Runner)" --branch stable --status success
+gh run list --repo tuna-os/tromso \
+  --workflow "Promote main to stable" --status success
```

### Test: append to `tests/pytest/test_release_candidate.py`

This test uses the existing `workflow()` helper. Checked against `main` @ `c0871d3`, without pytest: it fails today (`Login to GHCR (podman)`) and passes with the workflow edits above.

```python
def test_only_promotion_and_rollback_publish_stable():
    """:stable and tromso/stable/ move only through promote-stable.yml and rollback-stable.yml."""
    for s in workflow("build-final.yml")["jobs"]["build_final"]["steps"]:
        assert "refs/heads/stable" not in str(s.get("if", "")), s.get("name")
    assert workflow("build-iso.yml")[True]["workflow_run"]["branches"] == ["main"]
```

The `refs/heads/stable` branch in `scripts/resolve-image-tags.sh`, and its stable-ref cases in `test_publication_contract.py` and `test_resolve_image_tags.bats`, become unreachable from CI after this change. They are left in place on purpose (additive, no contract break), so they can be removed later on their own.

- [ ] `build-final.yml` pushes and scans only on `refs/heads/main`
- [ ] `build-iso.yml` `workflow_run` branches are `[main]`
- [ ] rollback dispatch description and runbook point at promotion runs, and the aarch64 row says the stable tags are not published
- [ ] `test_only_promotion_and_rollback_publish_stable` added and passing

Risk: irreversible or public-facing behaviour (which path may publish the user-facing `:stable` image and stable ISO). The park is only because of the workflow-file push ceiling: this lane's token cannot push `.github/workflows/`, so a lane or person who can must apply the spec above.
